title: Conjugacy of local Frobenius for isomorphic common-stage finite models
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a coefficient closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$. Let $L,L^\prime$ be finite intermediate coefficient fields and let $K,K^\prime$ be Weil complexes [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] over their canonical small coefficient models $E,E^\prime$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Assume their images in the common-stage Weil category are isomorphic. For a closed point $y$ of $Y_0$, two compatible $k_0$-embeddings $\iota,\iota^\prime:\kappa(y)\to k$, and every integer $j$, the operators on $\Omega\otimes_E H^j(C_{K,y,\iota})$ and $\Omega\otimes_{E^\prime}H^j(C_{K^\prime,y,\iota^\prime})$ obtained by scalar extension of the local geometric Frobenius [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] are conjugate by an $\Omega$-linear isomorphism. Scalar extension uses the actual embeddings of the small models into $\Omega$ from [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres]. No condition that either complex lie in the heart is imposed.

source.place: The Weil isomorphism intertwines the local operator with the operator at its translate; transport after the r-fold return. Common-stage coefficient comparison is the degreewise operator argument of lem-fd-local-weil-model-trace-independence, steps 1-8.

proof.text: Represent the isomorphism of the two included Weil pairs, its inverse and their equations at one finite coefficient extension. Apply the common-stage representative and eventual-equality criteria to the finite diagram, including the Weil intertwining equations. The result is an actual isomorphism of the two scalar-extended finite Weil pairs. The coefficientInclusion maps are conjugated inclusions through Shrink.algEquiv, so this argument applies in the scheme universe even when the closure has a different universe.

At a fixed residue embedding, pull that finite-stage isomorphism to the geometric point. Induct on localWeilIterate to intertwine the iterated Weil structures. Paste the natural point transport squares and the normalized pullback/composition/scalar squares to intertwine each of the three factors of the local operator. The proof is the operator part, steps 1-8, of lem-fd-local-weil-model-trace-independence, now applied to the actual small fields and a closed-point return. Apply H^j and the exact scalar/cohomology comparisons. Extend to the closure along the common-stage coefficient embedding and use the tensor tower comparisons to identify both boundaries with the embeddings in the statement.

For a second residue embedding, use the finite Frobenius orbit argument of lem-weil-local-frobenius-conjugacy-class at the small finite coefficient field: the embeddings differ by a power of Frobenius, and the composite point transports and Weil maps intertwines their cyclic return operators. Apply H^j and extend coefficients. Compose this conjugacy with the model conjugacy of the preceding step. The tensor tower identifications and functoriality of composition give exactly the displayed intertwining equality. For equal embeddings the orbit transport is the identity; for zero cohomology the unique map is the required isomorphism.

theorem sfLocalFrobenius_model_conjugacy
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y₀.hom]
    (L L' : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
    (K : sfWeilComplex D l hl Y₀ (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L))
    (K' : sfWeilComplex D l hl Y₀ (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L'))
    (hK : Nonempty (sfWeilStageObject D l hl Y₀ Ω L K ≅
      sfWeilStageObject D l hl Y₀ Ω L' K'))
    (y : {y : Y₀.left // y ∈ closedPoints Y₀.left})
    (ι ι' : Y₀.left.residueField y.val →+* D.k)
    (hι : ι.comp (Y₀.hom.residueFieldAlgebraMap y.val) = algebraMap D.k₀ D.k)
    (hι' : ι'.comp (Y₀.hom.residueFieldAlgebraMap y.val) = algebraMap D.k₀ D.k)
    (j : ℤ) :
    ∃ e :
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (sfAdicCoefficientEmbedding.{u} l Ω L)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.coefficientFdCohomology
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) j).obj
          (localPointComplex l _ D hl Y₀ K (localClosedPoint D Y₀ y ι hι))) ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (sfAdicCoefficientEmbedding.{u} l Ω L')).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.coefficientFdCohomology
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L') j).obj
          (localPointComplex l _ D hl Y₀ K' (localClosedPoint D Y₀ y ι' hι'))),
      e.hom ≫ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (sfAdicCoefficientEmbedding.{u} l Ω L')).map
          (localClosedFrobeniusCohomology l _ D hl Y₀ K' y ι' hι' j) =
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (sfAdicCoefficientEmbedding.{u} l Ω L)).map
          (localClosedFrobeniusCohomology l _ D hl Y₀ K y ι hι j) ≫ e.hom
